revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found — all quotes check out verbatim against the transcript. However, several issues require a targeted revision before this ships to a manager: (1) Overstated criticism of the rep's duplicate-lead handling: the rep actually DOES investigate the prior-Jake-contact disclosure within seconds (00:55 'let me see if there's a duplicate here', 01:09 'And Jake shots you a call?'), spending nearly a minute resolving it. cherry_pick_moments[0]'s 'prior_contact_probe_miss' framing and coaching_focus priority 1 (calling the unacknowledged bill-comment 'the single highest-value line in the call') both overstate the failure — this should be softened to a minor, low-stakes note rather than a top coaching priority, since the rep's overall duplicate-resolution behavior was procedurally sound. (2) Schema misuse: cherry_pick_moments[0] cites analysis_directives.friction_resolution_speed, which per the schema specifically applies to non-business COMPLAINTS (email/contact frequency harassment), not operational duplicate-lead information — this reference should be removed or replaced with a note that no schema section currently covers duplicate-lead handling (a TBD gap). cherry_pick_moments[1] cites coaching_philosophy.bill_anchoring, which governs the setter's own active bill-capture-and-flip within their own pitch, not acknowledging a customer's remark about sending a bill to a DIFFERENT rep on an abandoned call — this citation should be dropped or replaced with a more accurate reference (e.g., handoff_brief_discipline informational capture), and the classification label 'curiosity_creation_failure' is a mismatch and should be renamed. (3) Add a note about the unexplained ~28-second gap/dead air at 01:20-01:48 (rep says 'Hello? Can you hear me?') — likely a connection issue or the rep being absorbed in system lookup — this technical/call-quality context is relevant to fairly assessing the call's pacing and should be surfaced, at minimum as a footnote, rather than silently absorbed into criticism of the rep's responsiveness. (4) Soften trajectory_verdict language that implies Ion/Stewart has an established expectation for capturing 'deal velocity' intelligence on duplicate-lead calls — no such protocol exists in the schema; frame this as a suggested TBD/schema gap rather than an implied existing standard the rep failed to meet.
